archetypes.name: dyn-import-cycle
archetypes.rationale: Changed report imports should be checked against collection-time cycles.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed imports in batch_report.py and larch.state._escalation. Verify they bypass the run_logs facade without changing append_execution_issue behavior. Pay special attention to collection-time imports through run_log_flush, final_report, stall_recovery, and review batch flushing. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
